title: WCAG finding
description: One accessibility finding. Every wcag script emits this shape, and report.py consumes it.

id.description: Stable within one report, e.g. F-012

sc_title.description: The criterion's title from the specification

severity.description: Consequence for users, not conformance level. See references/severity.md.

location.description: file:line, page number, URL, or screen name

impact.description: Who is affected and what they cannot do

verification.description: How to confirm the fix worked

source.description: Whether a scanner or a person found it

confidence.description: needs-review when it depends on context that was not checked

agent_fix.description: Who can close it. direct: an agent can apply it and the value is derivable. app: needs the authoring application. recreate: the file cannot carry the fix, see skills/wcag-recreate. owner: needs content only the author has. design: needs a design decision. See references/desktop-agents.md.

rule.description: The scanner's own rule id, where one exists

matterhorn.description: Matterhorn Protocol checkpoint, for PDF findings
